notice: Architecture-level retention and deletion behaviour for each data class. Schedules are Design targets; no retention job, legal-hold engine or production erasure execution is implemented.
principles: Personal and regulated data has an owner, purpose, retention period and deletion behaviour before collection.
Regulated identity, analytics identity and audit records are separated; cross-domain joins fail closed.
Retention expiry is a deny signal; a record past its period is not used for recommendations, marketing or model evaluation.
Legal hold pauses deletion but does not extend ordinary processing purposes.
Data that is not collected has a zero-day period and a not-collected system of record.
